title: My Studio Neighbors
author: W. Hamilton (William Hamilton) Gibson
description: "My Studio Neighbors" by William Hamilton Gibson is a collection of essays written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The work offers an intimate glimpse into the joys of nature and the curiosities of life surrounding the author’s rural studio, blending personal reflections with observations of wildlife.

authorInfo.bio: W. Hamilton (William Hamilton) Gibson (1850–1896) wrote Camp Life in the Woods and the Tricks of Trapping and Trap Making. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
